description: This file defines the NetworkChangeNotifier class, which manages network state updates and observers in Chrome on Android. It includes methods for auto-detection, manual state forcing, and observer notifications related to network connectivity, connection type, cost, and network list management.

classes.description: Manages network state updates, observers, and auto-detection for Chrome on Android.
